name: navegador-ia-root
description: Root workspace for AI Agent Browser Native Desktop

scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:desktop
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -n "frontend,desktop" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "frontend,backend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
